text_block_list.text: When I visit the cafeteria to grab some lunch……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's why! Teach me some original recipes
using loooots of Tomakomai specialties!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Time to make food that'll make everyone feel totally buono~!
choice_data_list: Sounds like an interesting project, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you very much!
First, I think I'll make some daifuku. With this—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haskap and salmon!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With the sweetness of haskap and the saltiness of salmon,
we might be able to create a viral, unexpected recipe!
...If we figure out the taste somehow... I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
How about foil-baked salmon, then??
Stuffed with seasonal, bono ingredients from Tomakomai♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A "daifuku" like that might be good too! Well then, the next dish is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Simmered surf clams and haskap berries...
"Refreshing! Tomakomai Ramen Kai"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If we want it refreshing,
we should avoid making the soup turn purple—
Even after that, Hokko Tarumae's Tomakomai recipe ideas welled up like a spring. As a result...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All done!
A full Tomakomai course featuring all 80 items~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you, Akebono-san!
Everything looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: T-That's true... It's just a little bit, but--

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: As the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador, I will savor every last bit of it!
Hokko Tarumae is fired up, but this seems like a bit too much to handle...
choice_data_list: First, shouldn't we survey the audience's reactions?
Let's savor every bit of it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! That's true...
When doing PR, third-party feedback is vital.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Besides—that sort of thing is my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, Tomakomai♪
White land, paper fluttering in the air♪ Ah, Tomakomai♪"
Would you like a taste of delicious Tomakomai?"

Afterward, the two of them handed out food all across the cafeteria,
earning rave reviews from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best to share all the wonderful charms of Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmm-!! Wicked tasty!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, a recipe using ingredients from Tomakomai, huh?
—*slurp*... Hey, wanna go to a local fair next time?
And so, Hokko Tarumae thoroughly enjoyed her hometown's specialties and showed off their appeal to the entire academy.
